title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Consultor SAP Concur
description:
Temos 3 vagas disponível para essa posição, com diferentes senioridades: Pleno, Sênior e Especialista. Vem fazer parte do time!!!


Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho (Pode variar de acordo com as posições):

  • Atuar em processos de despesas (Expense), viagens corporativas (Travel) e contas a pagar (Invoice), de acordo com as instruções do cliente;
  • Apoiar usuários e aprovadores em dúvidas operacionais e uso da solução (web e mobile);
  • Realizar ajustes e configurações usuais na plataforma conforme orientações do cliente;
  • Produzir materiais simples (guias rápidos, FAQs) e registros quando solicitado;
  • Sinalizar riscos ou inconsistências observadas, encaminhando ao gestor do cliente.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência como Consultor SAP Concur;
  • Graduação completa.


Onde você vai trabalhar?:

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: FinCrime Escalations Officer
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you’ll be doing


  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes


What you'll need


  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: AI Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description:
AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities

  • Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.g., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops.
  • Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data.
  • System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes.
  • Local Scripting & Voice Strategy: Translate and adapt AI scripts to fit local linguistic nuances. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience.
  • QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify \"Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment.
  • Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions.

AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications

  • Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation.
  • Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows.
  • Technical Foundation:
  • Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data).
  • Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering .
  • Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.g., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts


How to Apply

Please send your resume in English.

title: Engenheiro de processos sênior
description:
A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética.

Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor.


MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias.


RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação.


Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa.


Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos.


Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional.


Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas.


Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção.


Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins.


Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado


Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA.

Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno.


Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.

title: IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer
description:
We are seeking a contractor to provide day-to-day remote support for an ageing 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment supporting HPC clusters within a data center setting. The engagement is focused on operational support, incident resolution, system health monitoring, filesystem support, and critical escalation coverage outside standard business hours. The IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer will be responsible for the ongoing support and maintenance of the storage environment. This includes monitoring, troubleshooting, break-fix support, routine health checks, and performance tuning of IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment. The role also requires participation in weekend on-call support for critical Severity 1 issues.


Location:

Brazil, Mexico


Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day remote operational support for a 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment
  • Monitor system health, alerts, capacity, and overall storage performance
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve storage-related incidents and service issues
  • Provide break-fix support and coordinate escalations where required
  • Support IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment
  • Assist with tuning and troubleshooting of parallel filesystem workloads
  • Carry out routine health checks and preventative maintenance activities
  • Support SAN-related troubleshooting, including fabric connectivity and multipathing
  • Participate in weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents only
  • Maintain clear documentation of incidents, resolutions, and operational recommendations


What we expect:

  • Proven hands-on experience with IBM ESS storage systems
  • Experience supporting IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in HPC environments
  • Good understanding of parallel filesystem workloads and HPC job patterns
  • Experience with SAN environments, including Brocade or Cisco fabrics, zoning, LUN masking, and multipathing
  • Strong Linux administration skills, particularly RHEL and SUSE
  • Working knowledge of the AIX command line
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken
  • Availability to work during EST business hours
  • Ability to provide weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents


Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting petabyte-scale storage environments
  • Background in data centre or scientific computing environments
  • Experience with performance tuning of GPFS / Spectrum Scale
  • Familiarity with supporting ageing infrastructure and maintaining operational stability
  • Experience in incident management and root cause analysis


We offer:

  • Highly competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours
  • Continuous education, mentoring, and professional development programs
  • Strong management and tech expertise
  • 12-month contract with possible extension

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js- Backend)
description:
About Us

HG Insights is the global leader in technology intelligence, delivering actionable AI driven insights through advanced data science and scalable big data solutions. Our platform informs go-to-market decisions, and we influence how businesses spend millions of marketing and sales budgets.

What You’ll Do

We’re searching for an experienced backend JavaScript engineer to join our product teams and help build systems that are simple, intuitive, and scalable. We develop big-data platforms using modern technologies and architectures, giving engineers the autonomy to learn, grow, and ship impactful products.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and fellow engineers on our Insights Platform, designing and building reliable backend services that power great user experiences. Our backend stack is primarily based on Node.js .

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Work as part of our Product Engineering teams
  • Architect, design, and implement service-oriented backend systems and APIs
  • Build, maintain, and evolve RESTful APIs
  • Collaborate on ideas across the team, from concept through production
  • Fix bugs quickly while continuously improving system reliability and performance
  • Participate in our on-call rotation and help investigate and resolve production issues
  • Attend daily stand-ups and planning sessions, collaborate at a fast pace, and help raise the engineering bar


What You’ll Need

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent real-world experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript , with a backend focus
  • Proven experience applying system and code design patterns in production environments
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Codex, Claude, Gemini) with advanced workflows
  • A self-learner and technology advocate comfortable working across different areas of the system
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-growing, high-ownership environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building or maintaining enterprise-grade SaaS applications with large datasets
  • Experience designing or building AI-powered features or systems
  • Experience working with Python
  • Enjoys startup culture where individual contributions are visible, impactful, and valued

Nooro is developing an innovative APP that aims to revolutionize the health app market, helping individuals with various health issues. We are seeking ambitious and dedicated individuals to join our creative team!


IMPORTANT: We don’t want average. We want the top 1%. If you’re not at that level, don’t apply. Our decision will be based on the quality of your portfolio


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We need short-form video editors who are exceptional, period. You must live and breathe editing.


If you’re not constantly pushing for better, this isn’t for you.


We expect top-tier performance, fresh ideas, and relentless attention to detail in everything you do.


If you’re not aiming to be the best, don’t waste your time.


We value creativity and want individuals who can bring fresh ideas and innovations to our editing team.

  • Experience creating fast-paced content for Meta, Shorts, and TikTok - you should know how to make it grab attention immediately and how to keep it.

  • Ability to use AI tools such as audio enhancement, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Agente CyberHelpDesk con Español - Portugues
description:
Lazarus Technology, líder en el sector de la ciberseguridad para aseguradoras, buscamos un agente con CyberHelpdesk con idiomas de Portugués y Español (ambos) con pasión por la tecnología y un compromiso firme con la seguridad de la información. Este rol es esencial para garantizar una experiencia segura y confiable para nuestros clientes, brindando soporte básico en caso de incidentes de seguridad. A través de medios como teléfono, chat, correo electrónico y sistemas de ticketing, serás la primera línea de atención junto con tus responsables, ayudando a nuestros clientes a resolver problemas de seguridad básicos. Este puesto ofrece la oportunidad de trabajar de manera remota, de lunes a viernes en horario laboral, permitiéndote equilibrar tu vida profesional y personal.


Responsabilidades:

  • Brindar asistencia directa a clientes que experimentan micro incidentes de seguridad, utilizando diversos medios de comunicación como teléfono, chat, correo electrónico y sistemas de ticketing.
  • Diagnosticar y resolver problemas técnicos relacionados con la seguridad de los equipos informáticos.
  • Soporte en incidentes de ciberseguridad.
  • Asesorar a clientes sobre medidas preventivas y mejores prácticas en seguridad para minimizar riesgos futuros.


Requisitos Obligatorios:

  • Excelente habilidad de comunicación oral y escrita en español y portugués. Si tienes un tercer idioma será bienvenido.
  • Excelente trato con clientes.
  • Conocimientos básicos en ciberseguridad, incluyendo comprensión de los incidentes de seguridad más actuales y medidas preventivas.
  • Experiencia previa en roles de soporte técnico en ciberseguridad o helpdesk es deseable.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma en un entorno remoto, y con el resto del equipo.


Ofrecemos:

  • La oportunidad de unirse a un equipo líder en el ámbito de la ciberseguridad en el mundo asegurador, donde podrás crecer profesionalmente y aportar a la seguridad de nuestros clientes.
  • Un entorno de trabajo flexible y remoto, permitiéndote trabajar desde cualquier lugar.
  • Horario laboral de lunes a viernes, con respeto por tu equilibrio entre vida laboral y personal.
  • Si tienes pasión por la tecnología y un firme compromiso con la seguridad, te invitamos a postularte a este rol vital dentro de nuestra empresa. Buscamos personas proactivas, listos para enfrentar los desafíos de la ciberseguridad en nuestro equipo.

title: Consultor SAP Concur
description:
Temos 3 vagas disponível para essa posição, com diferentes senioridades: Pleno, Sênior e Especialista. Vem fazer parte do time!!!


Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho (Pode variar de acordo com as posições):

  • Atuar em processos de despesas (Expense), viagens corporativas (Travel) e contas a pagar (Invoice), de acordo com as instruções do cliente;
  • Apoiar usuários e aprovadores em dúvidas operacionais e uso da solução (web e mobile);
  • Realizar ajustes e configurações usuais na plataforma conforme orientações do cliente;
  • Produzir materiais simples (guias rápidos, FAQs) e registros quando solicitado;
  • Sinalizar riscos ou inconsistências observadas, encaminhando ao gestor do cliente.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência como Consultor SAP Concur;
  • Graduação completa.


Onde você vai trabalhar?:

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

We are looking for Mid-Level Data Architect (AWS) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

Design and Improve an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines;

Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices.

Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation.

Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues.

Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data.

Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake.

Demonstrated experience with container orchestration technologies.

Implement data ingestion pipelines, transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency.

title: IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer
description:
We are seeking a contractor to provide day-to-day remote support for an ageing 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment supporting HPC clusters within a data center setting. The engagement is focused on operational support, incident resolution, system health monitoring, filesystem support, and critical escalation coverage outside standard business hours. The IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer will be responsible for the ongoing support and maintenance of the storage environment. This includes monitoring, troubleshooting, break-fix support, routine health checks, and performance tuning of IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment. The role also requires participation in weekend on-call support for critical Severity 1 issues.


Location:

Brazil, Mexico


Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day remote operational support for a 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment
  • Monitor system health, alerts, capacity, and overall storage performance
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve storage-related incidents and service issues
  • Provide break-fix support and coordinate escalations where required
  • Support IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment
  • Assist with tuning and troubleshooting of parallel filesystem workloads
  • Carry out routine health checks and preventative maintenance activities
  • Support SAN-related troubleshooting, including fabric connectivity and multipathing
  • Participate in weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents only
  • Maintain clear documentation of incidents, resolutions, and operational recommendations


What we expect:

  • Proven hands-on experience with IBM ESS storage systems
  • Experience supporting IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in HPC environments
  • Good understanding of parallel filesystem workloads and HPC job patterns
  • Experience with SAN environments, including Brocade or Cisco fabrics, zoning, LUN masking, and multipathing
  • Strong Linux administration skills, particularly RHEL and SUSE
  • Working knowledge of the AIX command line
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken
  • Availability to work during EST business hours
  • Ability to provide weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents


Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting petabyte-scale storage environments
  • Background in data centre or scientific computing environments
  • Experience with performance tuning of GPFS / Spectrum Scale
  • Familiarity with supporting ageing infrastructure and maintaining operational stability
  • Experience in incident management and root cause analysis


We offer:

  • Highly competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours
  • Continuous education, mentoring, and professional development programs
  • Strong management and tech expertise
  • 12-month contract with possible extension

title: Gerente de segurança da informação
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG.


Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais.


Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro.


Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas!

Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!


Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.


Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional.


Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua.


Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Principais atividades:


  • Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização.
  • Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros.
  • Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos.
  • Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS).
  • Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança.
  • Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura.
  • Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais.
  • Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura.
  • Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral.
  • Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos.
  • Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores.
  • Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins
  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos
  • Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR)


Conhecimento específicos:


  • Políticas de segurança
  • Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social.
  • Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos
  • Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização
  • Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Informações da vaga:


Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido)

Carga Horária: 220h

description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Sobre a vaga:

O DevOps será responsável por projetar, implantar e manter soluções de monitoramento, telemetria e rastreabilidade em ambientes Azure, garantindo visibilidade completa sobre aplicações, containers e serviços serverless.


Responsabilidades:

  • Deverá configurar e integrar ferramentas como Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics e Container Insights, estabelecendo padrões de observabilidade que suportem o diagnóstico de incidentes, análise de desempenho e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Atuará na automação de monitoramento via IaC, integração com pipelines DevOps e na definição de métricas de confiabilidade (SLO/SLI/SLA) para aplicações críticas.
  • Será responsável por implementar e acompanhar métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Mean Time to Recovery e Change Failure Rate), promovendo uma cultura orientada a dados e melhoria contínua na entrega de software.


Requisitos:

  • Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Container Insights.
  • Coleta e correlação de logs, métricas e traces.
  • Observabilidade em ambientes serverless (Functions, Logic Apps, App Services).
  • Observabilidade de containers e clusters AKS (Kubernetes).
  • Criação de dashboards e alertas personalizados (KQL, Workbooks, Grafana).
  • Integração de Application Insights com pipelines DevOps e ferramentas de APM.
  • Monitoramento de performance de aplicações (APM) e rastreamento distribuído.
  • Conceitos de SLA, SLO e SLI e aplicação prática em ambientes produtivos.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM) para provisionamento de recursos de observabilidade.
  • Automação de alertas e incidentes com Logic Apps, Azure Functions e Webhooks.
  • Conhecimento de containers, Kubernetes, Helm e Prometheus.
  • Métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, MTTR, Change Failure Rate) e integração com pipelines DevOps.

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

title: Senior IT Project Manager
description:
Senior IT Project Manager – Clinical & Life Sciences Technology

Location: Poland or Bulgaria or Brazil

Industry: Life Sciences | Clinical Technology | Software Platforms


We’re looking for a Senior IT Project Manager to lead the delivery of a cutting-edge clinical technology platform that supports risk-based quality management across global studies. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of IT, clinical operations, and regulatory compliance , helping life sciences organizations improve quality, efficiency, and oversight at scale.


What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex IT projects, ensuring success across scope, timeline, cost, quality, and value
  • Act as the primary client and business contact, building trusted relationships and ensuring stakeholder satisfaction
  • Lead cross-functional, matrixed, and global project teams (internal and external)
  • Develop and manage detailed project plans, budgets, resource models, and risk mitigation strategies
  • Proactively manage scope change, financial performance, and delivery risks
  • Ensure projects meet GxP, regulatory, and IT quality standards
  • Drive clear governance through steering committees, reporting, and KPIs
  • Support adoption of Agile and product-focused ways of working

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of IT project experience, including 2+ years leading full project lifecycles
  • Background delivering projects across clinical systems, enterprise solutions, infrastructure, or cybersecurity
  • Strong understanding of regulatory environments and quality-driven IT delivery
  • Proven experience managing budgets, forecasts, and financial performance
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfortable working independently in fast-paced, global environments


Nice to Have

  • Project Management, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Program Management certifications
  • Experience with global or multi-region projects
  • Knowledge of GxP requirements for IT delivery
  • Prior experience in life sciences, clinical trials, or regulated software platforms
  • Master’s degree or advanced qualification


We are an equal opportunities Recruitment Business and Agency. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js- Backend)
description:

HG Insights is the global leader in technology intelligence, delivering actionable AI driven insights through advanced data science and scalable big data solutions. Our platform informs go-to-market decisions, and we influence how businesses spend millions of marketing and sales budgets.

We’re searching for an experienced backend JavaScript engineer to join our product teams and help build systems that are simple, intuitive, and scalable. We develop big-data platforms using modern technologies and architectures, giving engineers the autonomy to learn, grow, and ship impactful products.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and fellow engineers on our Insights Platform, designing and building reliable backend services that power great user experiences. Our backend stack is primarily based on Node.js .

  • Build, maintain, and evolve RESTful APIs

  • Fix bugs quickly while continuously improving system reliability and performance
  • Participate in our on-call rotation and help investigate and resolve production issues
  • Attend daily stand-ups and planning sessions, collaborate at a fast pace, and help raise the engineering bar


What You’ll Need

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent real-world experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript , with a backend focus
  • Proven experience applying system and code design patterns in production environments
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Codex, Claude, Gemini) with advanced workflows
  • A self-learner and technology advocate comfortable working across different areas of the system
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-growing, high-ownership environment

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building or maintaining enterprise-grade SaaS applications with large datasets
  • Experience designing or building AI-powered features or systems
  • Experience working with Python
  • Enjoys startup culture where individual contributions are visible, impactful, and valued

title: AI Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description:
AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities

  • Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.g., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops.
  • Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data.

title: AI Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a senior Project Manager to join our team.

The ideal candidate must have a strong background in project management, specifically in the AI domain.


This role involves overseeing ongoing AI projects , managing client relationships , coordinating with internal teams , and ensuring the successful delivery of projects .

We are looking for individuals who are not only skilled in project management but also enthusiastic about AI and eager to drive new solutions.


While technical expertise is valuable, the primary focus is on project management , product ownership and client satisfaction . This role sits in the Digital Transformation Center and will be close to delivery and research teams.


  • Work model: remote from Brazil;
  • Contract type: contractor / “PJ”;
  • Availability to work according to North American’s Eastern Standard Time (EST).


Job Mission :

  • To manage AI projects, ensuring successful delivery.
  • To encourage a culture of excellence within the team.
  • To advance AI initiatives through cross-functional collaboration.
  • To engage across functions (SMEs, technical teams, leaderships) to guarantee delivery quality.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Project Management: Lead end-to-end project management for AI initiatives, from initiation to successful delivery. Develop project plans, allocate resources, track progress, and ensure timely completion of milestones and deliverables;
  • Client Engagement: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring clear communication. Understand client needs, manage expectations, and address concerns promptly to achieve customer satisfaction;
  • Risk Management: Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies. Proactively address issues that may impact project timelines, scope, or quality, ensuring smooth project execution;
  • Reporting and Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, and stakeholder communications. Ensure that project status and updates are communicated effectively to both internal teams and clients;
  • Team Leadership: Provide leadership and direction to project teams, fostering a collaborative and results-driven environment. Mentor team members, promote knowledge sharing, and support professional growth;
  • Global Approach: Interact with other regions, partners and ventures following a global approach to ensure consistency and alignment in AI project management across the organization.


Required Experience :

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Project Management, or a related field;
  • Experience in managing projects AI projects from conception to delivery;
  • Familiarity with AI technologies and their applications;
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools;
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate challenges and adapt to changing project requirements;
  • Critical thinking and problem solving to assess client situation and provide actionable outcome-based business/technical advice;
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or other relevant project management certifications (preferred);
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory;
  • Proficiency in Portuguese is desirable.


Required Technical Knowledge :

  • Familiarity with AI concepts, terminology, and industry trends;
  • Understanding of project management methodologies specific to AI projects;
  • Ability to evaluate technical feasibility and make informed project decisions based on technical considerations;
  • Proficiency in using project management software and tools for AI project tracking and management;
  • Knowledge and experience on conducting projects for IT and Service Desk solutions.
  • A background in IT environments, including an understanding of how various IT components and systems operate, is highly beneficial. This knowledge helps in navigating technical aspects, ensuring seamless integration of AI solutions within existing IT infrastructures;
  • Product ownership and ability to work in an agile environment and create user stories;
  • Excellent communication skills;
  • Strong project management skills.



What's next:

It's best to apply today, because job postings can be taken down and we wouldn't want you to miss this opportunity. To apply, please submit your updated English-written CV.

Diversity & Inclusion

Here at the Stefanini Group, we value plurality and equity, regardless of race, sexual orientation, disability, age, ancestry, religion, gender, and nationality. We understand and encourage the importance of being you!


About us

We are a Brazilian company with over 35 years of experience in delivering IT services worldwide, ranging from IT outsourcing to application development or IT staffing. We have a direct presence in 41 countries, through our 70 offices located throughout the world. We have managed to become the preferred partner of many small-to-midsize local and regional companies as well. Most of our clients come from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, telecommunications, chemical, services, technology, public sector and utilities.
